currentRoundInspection.method: Three official north-side pictures and one south-side aerial visually inspected; current standard viewer PMTiles components supply approximate fit. No bespoke surveys or PDFs.
observations: Roofless cruciform Gothic cathedral, hollow central crossing tower, taller ruined west tower house; broken wall tops and triangular transept gables.
North transept has three through-wall lancets and a small oculus; its adjacent narrow round tower carries a stone conical cap.
Cormac chapel is roofed, warm stone, with paired unequal square towers; one has a pyramidal roof.
Two lower parallel ranges have dark pitched roofs, selected broad dormers/merlons and sparse doors/windows; enclosure is a low hilltop boundary wall.
